DIAGNOSIS READY: Phyllodes Tumor

The clinical findings of a large, nontender, multinodular mass combined with mammographic features of a smooth polylobulated lesion and biopsy results showing leaf-like structures with stromal overgrowth are classic for a Phyllodes tumor. While fibroadenomas can present similarly, the size (6 cm) and specific histological description strongly favor this diagnosis.
